build_profile: Cargo release defaults, default features, runtime diagnostic tracing enabled
provenance_method: Source and executable identity are cohort-level attestations: Fastiplayer source and binary checked before final warmups; Fastiplayer executable checksum rechecked at assembly. VLC executable checksum is taken at assembly only. The collector did not independently hash each launched executable. Only the dedicated unchanged scored-cohorts directory is included.

source_ci.policy: automatic functional/quality checks and fast coverage baseline policy; full coverage is manual by owner decision

environment.audio_policy: decode/output active; player gain/volume zero; no audible-output proof
environment.device_access: DRM nodes available outside Codex sandbox; unavailable within sandbox

fixtures.provenance: FFmpeg testsrc2 960x540 upscaled to 3840x2160 before HEVC VA-API encoding, plus sine audio; simple synthetic spatial workload, not natural 4K content
Owner-supplied AV1 file, identified as Big Buck Bunny; Blender Foundation, CC BY 3.0; byte-identical reacquisition not established

hardware_decode_support.av1_measured_path: software; Fastiplayer FFmpeg backend, VLC dav1d 1.5.4 eight threads

measurement_configuration.fixture_cache: full sequential read before each launch; no cache drop
measurement_configuration.order: scenario H264,HEVC,AV1; odd repetitions Fastiplayer,VLC; even VLC,Fastiplayer
measurement_configuration.scope: launched process all threads; observed children invalidate attempt; compositor/audio server excluded
